name: Madmen
meaning: A place in Moab threatened with destruction
notes: Madmen, a place in Moab against which Jeremiah prophesied destruction ( Jeremiah 48:2 ).

name: Madmenah
meaning: A place near Jerusalem
notes: Madmenah, a place near Jerusalem mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy ( Isaiah 10:31 ).

name: Madon
meaning: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
notes: Madon, a Canaanite city whose king joined a coalition against Joshua but was defeated ( Joshua 11:1; 12:19 ).

name: Magadan
meaning: A place on the Sea of Galilee; home of Mary Magdalene
notes: Magadan (Dalmanutha), a place on the shore of the Sea of Galilee visited by Jesus ( Matthew 15:39; Mrk.8.10 ), possibly the hometown of Mary Magdalene ( Matthew 27:56, 61; 28:1; Mrk.15.40, 47; 16:1, 9; Luke 8:2; 24:10; Jhn.19.25; 20:1, 18 ).

name: Magbish
meaning: A place whose people returned from Babylonian exile
notes: Magbish, a place whose people are listed among those who returned to Judah from Babylonian exile ( Ezra 2:30 ).

name: Magog
meaning: A nation that will attack Israel in the future
notes: Magog, a nation that will join forces with Gog to attack Israel in the future, as prophesied in Ezekiel and Revelation ( Ezk.38.2; 39:6; Revelation 20:8 ).

name: Mahanaim
meaning: A place east of the Jordan; David's refuge
notes: Mahanaim, a place east of the Jordan River where Jacob met angels and David found refuge during Absalom's rebellion ( Genesis 32:2; 2Sa.17.24, 27 ).

name: Mahaneh-dan
meaning: A place between Zorah and Eshtaol; Samson's birthplace
notes: Mahaneh-dan, a place between Zorah and Eshtaol where the Spirit of the Lord began to stir Samson ( Judges 13:25; 18:12 ).

name: Makaz
meaning: A place in one of Solomon's administrative districts
notes: Makaz, a place in one of the twelve administrative districts established by Solomon ( 1Ki.4.9 ).

name: Makheloth
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped in the wilderness
notes: Makheloth, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey ( Numbers 33:25-26 ).

name: Makkedah
meaning: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
notes: Makkedah, a Canaanite city where Joshua defeated and executed five Amorite kings who had hidden in a cave ( Joshua 10:16-28 ).

name: Malta
meaning: An island where Paul was shipwrecked
notes: Malta, an island in the Mediterranean Sea where Paul was shipwrecked on his journey to Rome ( Act.28.1 ).

name: Mamre
meaning: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham
notes: Mamre, a place near Hebron where Abraham lived and built an altar to the Lord ( Genesis 13:18; 18:1 ).

name: Manahath
meaning: A place where Benjamites lived after the exile
notes: Manahath (Nohah), a place where some Benjamites lived after returning from the Babylonian exile ( 1Ch.8.6 ).

name: Maon
meaning: A city in Judah; home of Nabal and Abigail
notes: Maon, a city in the hill country of Judah ( Joshua 15:55 ), home of Nabal and Abigail ( 1Sa.25.2 ).

name: Marah
meaning: A place with bitter water on the Exodus route
notes: Marah, a place where the Israelites found bitter water that Moses made drinkable by casting a tree into it ( Exodus 15:23-25; Numbers 33:8-9 ).

name: Mareal
meaning: A place on the border of Zebulun
notes: Mareal, a place mentioned in describing the border of the territory of Zebulun ( Joshua 19:11 ).

name: Mareshah
meaning: A town in Judah; fortified by Rehoboam
notes: Mareshah, a town in the Shephelah of Judah ( Joshua 15:44 ), fortified by Rehoboam ( 2Ch.11.8 ) and the site of Asa's victory over Zerah the Ethiopian ( 2Ch.14.9-10 ).

name: Maroth
meaning: A town in Judah
notes: Maroth, a town in Judah mentioned in Micah's prophecy ( Micah 1:12 ).

name: Masrekah
meaning: The royal city of Samlah, an Edomite king
notes: Masrekah, the royal city of Samlah, one of the ancient kings of Edom before any Israelite king reigned ( Genesis 36:36; 1Ch.1.47 ).

name: Massah
meaning: A place where the Israelites tested God
notes: Massah, a place in the wilderness where the Israelites tested the Lord by demanding water ( Exodus 17:7; Deu.6.16; 9:22; 33:8; Psalm 95:8 ).

name: Mattanah
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
notes: Mattanah, a place where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness ( Numbers 21:18-19 ).

name: Mearah
meaning: A place near Sidon
notes: Mearah, a place near Sidon, mentioned in the description of the land yet to be conquered by the Israelites ( Joshua 13:4 ).

name: Meconah
meaning: A town inhabited by the people of Judah after the exile
notes: Meconah, a town inhabited by the people of Judah after their return from the Babylonian exile ( Nehemiah 11:28 ).

name: Medeba
meaning: A Moabite city captured by the Israelites
notes: Medeba, a city in Moab captured by the Israelites ( Numbers 21:30; Joshua 13:9, 16 ), later a site of battle between the Ammonites and David's army ( 1Ch.19.7 ).

name: Media
meaning: An ancient kingdom; part of the Persian Empire
notes: Media (Medes), an ancient kingdom in western Iran that, along with Persia, conquered Babylon and formed the Persian Empire ( 2Ki.17.6; 18:11; Esther 1:3, 14, 18; 10:2; Isaiah 21:2; Jeremiah 25:25; Dan.8.20 ).

name: Megiddo
meaning: A strategic city in the Jezreel Valley
notes: Megiddo, a strategically important city in the Jezreel Valley ( Joshua 12:21; 17:11; Judges 1:27; 5:19 ), fortified by Solomon ( 1Ki.9.15 ), and the site of King Josiah's death ( 2Ki.23.29-30; 2Ch.35.22 ).

name: Me-jarkon
meaning: A place in the territory of Dan
notes: Me-jarkon, a place in the territory allotted to the tribe of Dan ( Joshua 19:46 ).

name: Memphis
meaning: An important city in ancient Egypt
notes: Memphis, an ancient Egyptian city mentioned in prophecies of judgment against Egypt ( Isaiah 19:13; Jeremiah 2:16; 44:1; 46:14, 19; Ezk.30.13, 16; Hosea 9:6 ).

name: Mephaath
meaning: A Levitical city in Reuben, later Moabite
notes: Mephaath, a Levitical city in the territory of Reuben ( Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79 ), later mentioned in a prophecy against Moab ( Jeremiah 48:21 ).

name: Meribah
meaning: A place where the Israelites quarreled with Moses
notes: Meribah, a place where the Israelites quarreled with Moses and tested the Lord, and where water came from the rock ( Exodus 17:7; Deu.33.8; Psalm 95:8 ).

name: Meribah
meaning: A place where Moses disobeyed God
notes: Meribah-kadesh, a place where Moses disobeyed God by striking the rock to bring forth water ( Numbers 20:13, 24; 27:14; Deu.32.51; Psalm 81:7; 106:32; Ezk.47.19; 48:28 ).

name: Merom
meaning: A place where Joshua defeated Jabin's coalition
notes: Merom, a place near the waters of Merom where Joshua defeated a coalition of Canaanite kings led by Jabin king of Hazor ( Joshua 11:5, 7 ).

name: Meronothite
meaning: A term used to describe two individuals in the Bible
notes: Meronothite, a term used to describe Jehdeiah, who was in charge of King David's donkeys ( 1Ch.27.30 ), and Jadon, who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem ( Nehemiah 3:7 ).

name: Meroz
meaning: A place cursed for not helping against Sisera
notes: Meroz, a place cursed by the angel of the Lord for not coming to help fight against Sisera ( Judges 5:23 ).

name: Mesha
meaning: A place marking the Joktanite territory
notes: Mesha, a place mentioned as the limit of the territory settled by the descendants of Joktan ( Genesis 10:30 ).

name: Meshech
meaning: A nation, descendant of Japheth; associated with Tubal
notes: Meshech, a nation descended from Japheth ( Genesis 10:2 ), often mentioned together with Tubal as trading partners of Tyre ( Ezk.27.13 ) and allies of Gog ( Ezk.38.2, 3; 39:1 ).

name: Meshech-Tubal
meaning: Two nations mentioned together; defeated by Babylon
notes: Meshech-Tubal, two nations mentioned together as having been defeated by the Babylonians and lying in the grave with the uncircumcised ( Ezk.32.26 ).

name: Mesopotamia
meaning: The region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers
notes: Mesopotamia, the ancient region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, where Abraham lived before being called to Canaan ( Genesis 24:10; Act.7.2 ) and where the Israelites were oppressed by Cushan-rishathaim ( Judges 3:8, 10 ).

name: Michmash
meaning: A town in Benjamin; site of Saul's camp and Jonathan's victory
notes: Michmash, a town in Benjamin where Saul camped ( 1Sa.13.2, 5, 11, 16, 23 ) and near which Jonathan defeated a Philistine garrison ( 1Sa.14.5, 31 ).

name: Michmethath
meaning: A place on the borders of Ephraim and Manasseh
notes: Michmethath, a place on the border between the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh ( Joshua 16:6; 17:7 ).

name: Middin
meaning: A town in the wilderness of Judah
notes: Middin, a town in the wilderness of Judah ( Joshua 15:61 ).

name: Midian
meaning: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges
notes: Midian, a nation descended from Abraham through Keturah ( Genesis 25:2 ), which oppressed Israel during the time of the judges (Judges 6-8) and was later defeated by Gideon (Judges 7-8).

name: Migdal-el
meaning: A fortified city in Naphtali
notes: Migdal-el, a fortified city in the territory of Naphtali ( Joshua 19:38 ).

name: Migdal-gad
meaning: A town in the lowlands of Judah
notes: Migdal-gad, a town in the lowlands of Judah ( Joshua 15:37 ).

name: Migdol
meaning: A place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped
notes: Migdol, a place near the Red Sea where the Israelites camped during the Exodus ( Exodus 14:2; Numbers 33:7 ), and a city in Egypt mentioned in prophecies ( Jeremiah 44:1; 46:14; Ezk.29.10; 30:6 ).

name: Migron
meaning: A place near Gibeah where Saul camped
notes: Migron, a place near Gibeah where Saul camped with his troops ( 1Sa.14.2 ), and a town mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy about the Assyrian invasion ( Isaiah 10:28 ).

name: Miletus
meaning: A city in Asia Minor visited by Paul
notes: Miletus, a city in Asia Minor where Paul met with the elders of the Ephesian church on his way to Jerusalem ( Act.20.15, 17 ) and where Trophimus was left ill ( 2Ti.4.20 ).
